messages:
lee: Heads up 1 - I'm refreshing the Quickstart web guide to show the OAuth / redirect flow for SPAs + server apps. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482. Need a quick review on the Node/TS snippet and CORS notes.

toni: Nice. Are we still recommending the client-side implicit flow anywhere? We should avoid suggesting it for new apps.

lee: No implicit flow. Two examples: 1) server-side exchange (recommended) and 2) minimal SPA with PKCE. Both use the new SDK auth helpers.

rahul: Can you paste the Node snippet? I'll run it locally. Also add a line about allowed redirect URIs in Dedicated (customers often forget).

lee: Node snippet in PR:```js
// server exchange example
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
// receive code from redirect
const token = await client.auth.exchangeCode({ code, redirect_uri: 'https://app.example.com/callback' })
console.log('access token', token.access_token)
```

toni: Small nit: our SDK init now expects { tokenProvider } in the browser. The server example is fine but add a short browser PKCE snippet too.

lee: Added PKCE example:```js
// browser (PKCE)
import { createPKCEFlow } from '@redwood/sdk/browser'
const flow = createPKCEFlow({ clientId: 'client_abc', redirectUri: location.origin + '/cb' })
flow.start()
```

rahul: Ran the server example. Works but the response shape changed (auth.token -> auth.tokens). Docs-bot: left lint warning on codeblock fences.

docs-bot: lint: replace triple-backtick fence with language tag for JS blocks in docs/quickstart/web.md line 98.

lee: Fixed fences and pushed. Also added a short Troubleshooting section about CORS and allowed origins for Dedicated customers.

toni: Can we also include a curl example for rotating client secrets (for infra teams)? A one-liner would help.

lee: Added curl rotate snippet + link to the security rotation guide.

devops-bot: preview build queued for branch docs/quickstart/oauth-refresh (job #9012) :gear:

preview-bot: preview available: https://deploy-preview-1482--docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/web-onboarding

rahul: Preview looks good. Two edge cases: 1) older SDKs lack exchangeCode API (need migration note), 2) iOS WebView OAuth redirect quirk - suggest adding a short comment.

lee: Added migration callout (old init -> new tokenProvider) and iOS WebView tip. Also added an internal link to /migrations/oauth-web.

toni: Left one wording nit about 'client secret' -> 'client credential' in server examples (some customers use HMAC secrets).

lee: Fixed wording. Anyone want to give a final pass? We want this live before next week's onboarding workshop.

rahul: LGTM; approved.

toni: Approved after one small grammar tweak.

docs-bot: PR #1482 merged into main by lee 1 - docs site redeployed (job #9012) :white_check_mark:

lee: Thanks team. If you see any follow-ups from the workshop, I'll open a small follow-up PR for additional examples.
